eyebrow: On-prem and VM-hosted SQL Server only
code:
BACKUP DATABASE Sales TO DISK = 'D:\Backups\Sales_Full.bak'
  WITH INIT, COMPRESSION;

BACKUP DATABASE Sales TO DISK = 'D:\Backups\Sales_Diff.bak'
  WITH DIFFERENTIAL, COMPRESSION;

RESTORE DATABASE Sales FROM DISK = 'D:\Backups\Sales_Full.bak'
  WITH NORECOVERY;   -- more backups coming, stay in restoring state
RESTORE LOG Sales FROM DISK = 'D:\Backups\Sales_Log2.trn'
  WITH RECOVERY;     -- last step in the chain — bring it online
caption: DIFFERENTIAL makes it incremental. NORECOVERY keeps the chain open.
